name: Cartes Bancaires
note: French card-payment scheme, a Groupement d'Intérêt Économique; a 'Partenaire Majeur' on the FDJ-SUEZ partners page and named on the jersey by The Inner Ring (Aug 2026). The GIE's own site describes the group and shows its principal member banks only as logos, with no ownership statement in the text, so no ownership claim yet; left not rated.
